title: Knowledge Graph declaration
description: A Declaration. Any field not listed here is an Extension: A field of a Declaration, or of one of its entries, that is not defined here. A reader that does not recognise the field ignores it, and the rest of the Declaration keeps its meaning.

name.description: The Knowledge Graph's name. The declaration file is `<name>.json`.

id.description: The Subgraph's name, unique within its Knowledge Graph.

path.description: The directory, relative to the declaration.

anyOf.description: A Subgraph of Skills: the instructions an Actor follows to carry out a Task.
A Subgraph of Node Schemas: files that state the shape other files must have.
A Subgraph of Roles: the responsibilities an Actor takes on, and who takes them on.
A Subgraph of Processes: BPMN diagrams that coordinate Tasks, and the decision tables their gateways compute from.
A Subgraph describing the language models an Actor may be: which languages each is good at, and whether a person checked.
A Subgraph recording every term a Knowledge Graph's Processes have ever named, and when each stopped being used, so a retired term is never silently reused.

A Graph Kind a Harness defines. To a reader that knows only bootstrap it is an Extension: A field of a Declaration, or of one of its entries, that is not defined here. A reader that does not recognise the field ignores it, and the rest of the Declaration keeps its meaning.

items.description: A named set of Node Kinds whose instances may be held together.

title.description: A short name for people, shown as its README's heading.

description.description: What it holds, in a sentence or two, shown under that heading.

items.description: A named subset of Node Instances: a Declaration's directory entry, with its id, its directory and its Graph Kinds.

src.description: The file, relative to the declaration.

role.description: The part the file plays, such as `instance-readme`.

items.description: A Declaration's file entry: one file about the repository itself, such as its README, with its stated purpose.

Node.title: Node
Node.description: One unit of recorded knowledge, held in one file or as one identifiable part of a file, and named by an IRI.

NodeKind.title: NodeKind
NodeKind.description: A name for a class of Nodes, together with its Node Schema: a JSON Schema that every Node of that kind satisfies.

NodeInstance.title: NodeInstance
NodeInstance.description: A Node that states its Node Kind and satisfies that kind's Node Schema.

GraphKind.title: GraphKind

anyOf.description: A Subgraph of Skills: the instructions an Actor follows to carry out a Task.
A Subgraph of Node Schemas: files that state the shape other files must have.
A Subgraph of Roles: the responsibilities an Actor takes on, and who takes them on.
A Subgraph of Processes: BPMN diagrams that coordinate Tasks, and the decision tables their gateways compute from.
A Subgraph describing the language models an Actor may be: which languages each is good at, and whether a person checked.
A Subgraph recording every term a Knowledge Graph's Processes have ever named, and when each stopped being used, so a retired term is never silently reused.

A Graph Kind a Harness defines. To a reader that knows only bootstrap it is an Extension: A field of a Declaration, or of one of its entries, that is not defined here. A reader that does not recognise the field ignores it, and the rest of the Declaration keeps its meaning.

GraphKind.description: A named set of Node Kinds whose instances may be held together.

Declaration.title: Declaration
Declaration.description: A JSON document, `<name>.json`, that gives a name and lists entries, each naming either a directory of Node Instances with the Graph Kinds they belong to, or a single file with its purpose.

Subgraph.title: Subgraph
Subgraph.description: A named subset of Node Instances: a Declaration's directory entry, with its id, its directory and its Graph Kinds.

Asset.title: Asset
Asset.description: A Declaration's file entry: one file about the repository itself, such as its README, with its stated purpose.

Extension.title: Extension
Extension.description: A field of a Declaration, or of one of its entries, that is not defined here. A reader that does not recognise the field ignores it, and the rest of the Declaration keeps its meaning.

KnowledgeGraph.title: KnowledgeGraph
KnowledgeGraph.description: A semi-static description of one or more datasets or information repositories as of one version: a set of Node Schemas and Node Instances, and the Declaration that divides them into Subgraphs. Published as JSON-LD, each Subgraph is a named graph.

Dependency.title: Dependency
Dependency.description: One Knowledge Graph depends on another when its Declaration names the other. The dependent's Nodes may refer to the other's; the other's never refer back.

Content.title: Content
Content.description: The Node Kinds whose instances describe the datasets and other information a Knowledge Graph is about: their records, documents, catalogues and terms, and links to other sources of knowledge inside or outside the repository.

Actor.title: Actor
Actor.description: A person, an agent or a program that can carry out work.

Task.title: Task
Task.description: A unit of work an Actor carries out: what it needs to begin, and what it produces.

Skill.title: Skill
Skill.description: The Node Kind whose instances are natural-language instructions an Actor follows to carry out one Task.

Tool.title: Tool
Tool.description: The Node Kind whose instances describe a program an Actor may run while carrying out a Task: what it takes, what it produces, and how to run it.

Role.title: Role
Role.description: The Node Kind whose instances name a responsibility an Actor takes on when carrying out Tasks, and list the Skills that responsibility needs.

ProcessNode.title: ProcessNode
ProcessNode.description: One element of a BPMN diagram: a Task, a decision, a start or an end.

SequenceFlow.title: SequenceFlow
SequenceFlow.description: An arrow in a BPMN diagram, from one Process Node to the next.

Process.title: Process
Process.description: The Node Kind whose instances coordinate Tasks: a BPMN diagram whose Process Nodes are joined by Sequence Flows, in lanes that each name the Role an Actor takes to carry out that lane's Tasks.

Harness.title: Harness
Harness.description: A Knowledge Graph whose Subgraphs hold Skills, Tools, Roles and Processes: what an Actor needs in order to work with another Knowledge Graph.
